description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementReport controller class for the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages the preparation of data for the leave entitlement report view, including subunit options, location options, and the current leave period, using associated services.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing data and rendering the leave entitlement report view in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LocationService instance used to fetch accessible location data.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CompanyStructureService instance used to retrieve subunit data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for the leave entitlement report component, including subunits, locations, and the current leave period, and sets the component for rendering.
